hints.title: Prefix Multiplication Obstacle
hints.text: Each root-to-leaf path represents a number formed by concatenating node digits. How can passing the accumulated prefix value down to child nodes compute each leaf number in a single traversal pass?

hints.title: Decimal Shift Invariant
hints.text: At each step, transitioning to a child multiplies the current running number by 10 and adds the child digit. At leaves, return the completed number.

hints.title: Recursive Prefix Sum Procedure
hints.text: Define a recursive helper taking the current node and running value. Multiply running value by 10 and add node.val. If node is a leaf, return this accumulated value. Otherwise, return the sum of recursive calls on left and right children, ignoring null branches.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single depth-first pass passing down integer prefixes in O(1) word operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting paths to strings and parsing adds unnecessary heap allocations and string concatenation overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Passing the arithmetic accumulator down rather than assembling string paths.
